FED’S HAMMACK: THE FED SHOULD PREPARE FOR POSSIBLE TREASURY MARKET INTERVENTION WHILE CONDITIONS ARE CALM

IN A SPEECH AT THE BROOKINGS INSTITUTION, PRESIDENT HAMMACK SAID THE FOMC SHOULD ESTABLISH PRINCIPLES FOR WHEN AND HOW TO INTERVENE IN TREASURY MARKETS, AND HOW TO COMMUNICATE THOSE ACTIONS.

17 NOV 2026

IT’S TIME FOR THE FEDERAL RESERVE TO ESTABLISH CLEAR PRINCIPLES FOR WHEN AND HOW TO INTERVENE IN THE MARKET FOR US TREASURY BONDS, ACCORDING TO BETH HAMMACK, THE PRESIDENT AND CEO OF THE FEDERAL RESERVE BANK OF CLEVELAND.

IN A SPEECH AT THE BROOKINGS INSTITUTION IN WASHINGTON DC, PRESIDENT HAMMACK NOTED THAT THE $32 TRILLION TREASURY MARKET RAN INTO TURBULENCE IN MARCH 2020 AT THE ONSET OF COVID-19 AND AGAIN IN RESPONSE TO TARIFF NEWS IN APRIL 2025.

NOW’S THE TIME TO LEARN FROM PREVIOUS EPISODES—AND HOPEFULLY PREVENT THE NEXT ONE, PRESIDENT HAMMACK SAID.

“WHEN STRESS HITS, THERE MAY BE VERY LITTLE TIME TO DECIDE WHAT PRINCIPLES TO OPERATE UNDER OR HOW TO COMMUNICATE THEM,” SHE SAID. “IT IS BETTER TO IDENTIFY THE EXIT ROUTES WHEN YOU FIRST ENTER THE BUILDING THAN IT IS TO DRAW UP AN EVACUATION PLAN AS THE BUILDING IS FILLING WITH SMOKE.”

PRESIDENT HAMMACK PROVIDED IDEAS FOR WHAT THOSE PLANS COULD ENTAIL IN HOPES THAT THEY’LL SERVE AS A CATALYST FOR DISCUSSION ON THE FEDERAL OPEN MARKET COMMITTEE.

“THE FOMC HAS A RESPONSIBILITY TO THINK CAREFULLY ABOUT WHEN AND HOW WE SHOULD USE OUR POWERFUL TOOLS,” SHE SAID.

KEY QUOTES:

THE FED’S ROLE IN TREASURY MARKETS

“IF THE TREASURY MARKET ISN'T WORKING, THE MARKETS BUILT ON TOP OF IT CAN'T WORK, EITHER. DYSFUNCTION IN THE FOUNDATION CAN TRAVEL UPWARD AND SPREAD INTO THE REAL ECONOMY.”

“WHEN EVERYONE WANTS CASH AT THE SAME TIME, RAPID SELLING MAY DEPRESS THE VALUE OF TREASURIES. THIS DEPRESSION IS NOT DRIVEN BY THE INTRINSIC VALUE OR CREDITWORTHINESS OF TREASURIES AND IS NOT A PROBLEM PRIVATE MARKETS CAN SOLVE ON THEIR OWN. RATHER, IT IS EXACTLY THE KIND OF PROBLEM A CENTRAL BANK WAS DESIGNED TO ADDRESS.”

WHEN THE FED SHOULD INTERVENE

“IF THERE’S EVIDENCE THAT TREASURY MARKET DYSFUNCTION WILL SPILL INTO THE REAL ECONOMY AND THAT FED ACTION CAN ADDRESS THE PROBLEM, THEN INTERVENTION SHOULD BE CONSIDERED.”

“WHEN POOR LIQUIDITY CONDITIONS IN VOLATILE MARKETS REFLECT FUNDAMENTALS, IT IS NOT A PROBLEM THE FED CAN OR SHOULD TRY TO SOLVE.”

HOW IT SHOULD INTERVENE

“THE PRESUMPTION SHOULD BE THAT THE ACTION IS TEMPORARY AND TARGETED, IDEALLY WITH AN EXIT STRATEGY BUILT IN FROM THE START.”

“I SUPPORT ENHANCEMENTS TO SRP (STANDING REPURCHASE AGREEMENT) OPERATIONS TO INCREASE THEIR EFFECTIVENESS. FOR EXAMPLE, MAKING THEM AVAILABLE AT ANY TIME DURING THE BUSINESS DAY AND PERHAPS LINKING THEM TO THE FEDNOW® SERVICE SO THAT FUNDS CAN BE AVAILABLE EVEN BEFORE 8 AM ET.”

“I DOUBT REPOS WOULD HAVE BEEN ENOUGH IN 2020. THUS, IT MAY MAKE SENSE TO CONSIDER TREASURY PURCHASES IF REPO OPERATIONS PROVE INSUFFICIENT.”

“SPRINKLERS CAN’T ALWAYS PUT OUT THE FIRE; SOMETIMES YOU NEED A FIREFIGHTER’S HOSE.”

HOW TO COMMUNICATE ABOUT TREASURY MARKET ACTIONS

“FED COMMUNICATIONS SHOULD CLEARLY DISTINGUISH POLICY ACTIONS FROM MARKET-FUNCTIONING ACTIONS. CLEAR COMMUNICATION IS NOT MERELY A COURTESY. INSTEAD, IT’S PART OF WHAT MAKES THE INTERVENTION WORK AND PART OF WHAT MAKES THE EXIT CREDIBLE.”

“IN THE FUTURE, A CLEAR DELINEATION OF INTENT WOULD PROVIDE THE PUBLIC WITH INSIGHT INTO WHEN INTERVENTION WOULD NO LONGER BE NEEDED AND THE CONDITIONS UNDER WHICH THE FOMC WOULD UNWIND THE PURCHASES.”
